scope.description: Diet plan: Winter Arc Meal Plan (2,900 kcal)

recipes.name: Tiramisu overnight oats
recipes.steps:
In the jar, stir together the oats, milk, espresso (or 1 tsp instant coffee in 30 ml hot water), a pinch of salt and half the honey.
Mix the skyr with the rest of the honey and spoon it on top as a separate layer.
Dust with cocoa, grate the chocolate over, lid it, and refrigerate overnight. Eat it cold.
recipes.notes: Per jar. Her: 55 g oats · 110 ml milk · 150 g skyr · 10 g honey · 8 g cocoa · 8 g dark chocolate. Sunday prep: 6 jars (Mon-Wed), Thursday: 4 jars (Thu-Fri).

recipes.name: Prosciutto egg ciabatta
recipes.steps:
Toast the ciabatta.
Scramble the eggs low and slow, and pull them off while they still look a bit wet.
Pile on the eggs, torn mozzarella, prosciutto, tomatoes and basil. Salt and pepper.
recipes.notes: Sat + Sun. Her: 2 eggs · 70 g ciabatta · 25 g prosciutto · 25 g light mozzarella.

recipes.name: Chicken pesto pasta
recipes.steps:
Butterfly the chicken so it cooks evenly. Season hard with salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano.
Sear it in the oil over high heat for 5-6 min a side until the centre hits 74 °C. Rest 5 min, then slice.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 min. Save a mug of pasta water before you drain.
Blister the tomatoes in the chicken pan for 3 min to pick up the browned bits.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with pesto, parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Heat makes pesto go dark and bitter.
Split into 6 containers (4:3, yours bigger) and top each with chicken, tomatoes, lemon zest and chili.
recipes.notes: Batch for two (3 + 3, split 4:3): 950 g chicken breast · 510 g pasta · 600 g broccoli · 600 g cherry tomatoes · 150 g pesto · 75 g parmesan · 25 g olive oil · 2 lemons (zest). Her portion: about 130 g chicken, 70 g pasta.

recipes.name: Porchetta-style pork + roast potatoes
recipes.steps:
Heat the oven to 220 °C. Chunk the potatoes, toss with 40 g oil, salt and half the rosemary, and roast 20 min.
Crush the fennel seeds and garlic with the rest of the rosemary, the lemon zest, chili, salt and 15 g oil. Rub it all over the pork.
Sear the pork in 20 g oil for 2 min a side.
Add the sliced peppers and onion to the potato trays, set one tenderloin on each, and roast 15-18 min until the centre reads 63 °C.
Rest 10 min before slicing. Squeeze lemon over everything and spoon on the pan juices.
Eat with ciabatta for mopping up the juices.
recipes.notes: Batch for two (3 + 3, split 4:3): 1 kg pork tenderloin · 2 kg potatoes · 5 bell peppers · 2 red onions · 75 g olive oil · 6 garlic cloves · 1.5 tbsp fennel seeds · 1.5 tbsp rosemary · 2 lemons. Ciabatta: 50 g yours, 35 g hers. Her portion: about 145 g pork, 280 g potatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken cacciatore + rice
recipes.steps:
Season the thighs and brown them in 2 batches in 25 g oil for 4 min a side. Take them out.
In the remaining 25 g oil, cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms for 6 min, then the garlic for 1 min.
Pour in the wine and let it reduce by half while you scrape up the browned bits.
Add the tomatoes, oregano, a rosemary sprig, 2 bay leaves, chili and the olives, return the chicken, cover, and simmer 30 min.
Cook the rice while it simmers. Portion into 6 containers (4:3, yours bigger). It tastes even better on day 2.
recipes.notes: Batch for two (3 + 3, split 4:3): 1 kg chicken thighs · 560 g rice · 800 g passata · 250 g mushrooms · 2 bell peppers · 2 onions · 5 garlic cloves · 75 g black olives · 175 ml red wine · 50 g olive oil. Her portion: about 145 g thighs, 75 g rice.

recipes.name: Steak tagliata + rosemary potatoes
recipes.steps:
Thursday prep: roast the potatoes with olive oil, rosemary, smashed garlic and salt on 2 trays at 220 °C for 35-40 min, then split into 6 containers (4:3, yours bigger).
Each night: take the steak out 20 min before cooking, pat it dry, and salt it well.
Get the pan smoking hot. Cook 2-3 min a side for medium-rare (2 cm thick), with a garlic clove and rosemary in for the last minute.
Rest 5 min. Meanwhile, crisp the potatoes in the same pan.
Slice thin against the grain. Serve over rocket and halved tomatoes, then add parmesan, balsamic and flaky salt.
recipes.notes: Steak is cooked fresh each night. Potato batch (Thursday, 3 + 3): 2.3 kg potatoes · 50 g olive oil · rosemary · 5 garlic cloves. Her: 150 g steak · 4 g oil · 10 g parmesan · about 320 g potatoes.

recipes.name: Pork ragù pappardelle
recipes.steps:
Brown the pork shoulder (cut into 6 chunks) hard in 2 batches, 8-10 min each. That crust is the flavour, so don't rush it. Take it out.
Cook the finely diced onion, carrot and celery for 8 min until soft and sweet. Add the garlic for 1 min.
Add the wine and reduce by half. Then add the passata, 350 ml water, 3 bay leaves, rosemary, chili, salt and the pork.
Cover and simmer on very low for 2.5-3 hours, until the pork falls apart. Shred it with 2 forks, season, and split it into 8 containers: 4 bigger ones for you, 4 smaller ones for her.
Freeze the last 4 portions (2 each) for next Sunday.
Toss your portion with 100 g pappardelle, 15 g parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
recipes.notes: Ragù batch (8 portions: 4 yours, 4 hers; made every other week): 1.25 kg boneless pork shoulder · 2 onions, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks · 5 garlic cloves · 35 g olive oil · 250 ml dry red wine · 1 kg passata · 3 bay leaves · rosemary · chili · salt. Her: 70 g pappardelle · 10 g parmesan.

recipes.name: Pork ragù on polenta
recipes.steps:
Brown the pork shoulder (cut into 6 chunks) hard in 2 batches, 8-10 min each. That crust is the flavour, so don't rush it. Take it out.
Cook the finely diced onion, carrot and celery for 8 min until soft and sweet. Add the garlic for 1 min.
Add the wine and reduce by half. Then add the passata, 350 ml water, 3 bay leaves, rosemary, chili, salt and the pork.
Cover and simmer on very low for 2.5-3 hours, until the pork falls apart. Shred it with 2 forks, season, and split it into 8 containers: 4 bigger ones for you, 4 smaller ones for her.
Freeze the last 4 portions (2 each) for next Sunday.
Spoon your portion over 90 g quick polenta (cooked as the pack says, salted) with 15 g parmesan.
recipes.notes: Ragù batch (8 portions: 4 yours, 4 hers; made every other week): 1.25 kg boneless pork shoulder · 2 onions, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks · 5 garlic cloves · 35 g olive oil · 250 ml dry red wine · 1 kg passata · 3 bay leaves · rosemary · chili · salt. Her: 65 g polenta · 10 g parmesan.

recipes.name: Bresaola panino
recipes.steps: Toast the bread, stack bresaola, mozzarella and rocket, add a drizzle of balsamic and black pepper, and eat. On gym days, eat it 1.5-2 hours before training.
recipes.notes: Her: 70 g ciabatta · 45 g bresaola · 45 g light mozzarella. Build it fresh: made ahead, the bread goes soggy. Budget swap: lean cooked ham instead of bresaola.

dietPlans.name: Winter Arc – you (2,900 kcal)
dietPlans.notes: Your meals, about 2,900 kcal and 190 g protein a day. Gym days: Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat. Prep on Sunday (Sun + Mon-Wed) and Thursday (Thu-Sat).

dietPlans.name: Winter Arc – for two
dietPlans.notes: Your portion plus hers (about 3/4 of yours, banana 1 each) in every meal: apply this one when the shopping list should cover both of you. Her days come to about 2,100 kcal and 140 g protein.
